## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `coverage-ratio-conditioned-evidence`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-08-09T06:06:13.120Z.

Context relevance ledger (33): coverage-ratio conditioning — a signal derived from a gate's verdict must be discounted by the fraction of the relevant population that gate actually examined, because a pass over a hand-picked sample and a pass over the whole tree carry different information and currently score identically.

Recorded 2026-08-09. Extends the catalog; no prior entry is restarted or renumbered. Distinct from entry (32), epoch-conditioned evidence confidence, which discounts a measurement by whether the contract that produced it is still current. This entry discounts by breadth rather than by age: a verdict can be perfectly current and still cover a small, self-selected slice of what it names.

Gap this closes. The engine already treats gate verdicts and validation results as evidence when assembling context, and treats a passing gate as positive evidence about the surface it names. That inference is only sound when the gate examined the surface. Measured this pass: surface-replication-sets.json passes while covering zero of the five actual replication sites of the status-token normalization rule; smoke-external-packages.mjs would report ok over ten of eighteen published packages and runs in no workflow. Both are honest passes over unrepresentative samples, and an assembly that cites either as 'this surface is verified' is overstating what is known.

Mechanism. For each gate that can be cited as evidence, carry two numbers alongside the verdict: examined, and the population it claims to speak for. Where the population is computable — files matching the gate's own trigger globs, packages matching the discovery query, symbols in the declared surface — compute it; where it is not computable, mark the ratio unknown, which is itself the signal that the gate cannot be cited as coverage. Scale the evidence weight by that ratio, and surface the ratio in the served envelope next to the verdict so a reading agent can see the difference between verified and sampled.

Second-order use. The ratio is a work-selection signal in its own right. A gate with high citation frequency and a low or unknown coverage ratio is the highest-leverage thing to widen, because it is the point where the record is most confidently wrong. That ordering is computable from data the tracker already holds and needs no new judgement.

Relation to prior entries. (30) priced signal admission by marginal information per unit of compute; this entry prices a signal already admitted, by how much of its claimed domain it observed. The two compose: coverage ratio is cheap to compute for any gate whose trigger set is declared, so it clears (30)'s exchange rate at essentially every corpus size.

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
